criteria.criterion: Invalid-then-valid output completes in one Agent run reporting exactly two requests under one shared UsageLimits; verified by real-FunctionModel tests.

A complete 5,000-char failed response is on the retry wire only when the full request plus output reserve provably fits (input_tokens + effective_max_tokens <= window for every candidate); verified by a fit test.
When it does not fit — or the count is unknown — zero chars of it reach the wire while all_messages() retains all 5,000; verified by omit + unknown-count tests.
Authoritative-input overflow raises ContextWindowExceededError with no shortening of system/user/tool content; verified by an oversize-input test.
length/max_tokens consumes at most the shared output-retry allowance and sends exactly the concision instruction from Approach §2; verified by success + exhaustion cases.
Refusal/content-filter stays terminal after one model call, triggering neither output retry nor fallback; verified by call- and candidate-count assertions.

The NativeOutput branch still selects via output_mode, runs under the shared bounded operation with pai_output.guard_capability() attached (NOT the concision guard), keeps truncation TERMINAL, and preserves the bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback to the prompted path; verified by native-run and 895c-fallback tests.
The combined allowance is documented in the pai_retry.py docstring, and no per-attempt reset path remains; verified by that docstring plus a source-census and budget test.
